_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); cruise-line signals

pit_profile.why: Royal Caribbean: 'Together, our Global Brands and our Partner Brands have a combined fleet of 68 ships in the cruise vacation industry with an aggregate capacity of approximately 166,900 berths as of December 31, 2024'; 'We compete with a number of cruise lines as well as land-based vacation alternatives for consumers’ leisure time'; 'We may lose business to competitors throughout the vacation market'; and 'Demand for cruises is affected by international, national, and local economic conditions' (its own FY2024 10-K): a cruise-fleet franchise whose demand follows the economies it sells into, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: Royal Caribbean: 'Together, our Global Brands and our Partner Brands have a combined fleet of 68 ships in the cruise vacation industry with an aggregate capacity of approximately 166,900 berths as of December 31, 2024'; 'We compete with a number of cruise lines as well as land-based vacation alternatives for consumers’ leisure time'; 'We may lose business to competitors throughout the vacation market'; and 'Demand for cruises is affected by international, national, and local economic conditions' (its own FY2024 10-K): a cruise-fleet franchise whose demand follows the economies it sells into, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.44x; +33% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.14; conservative 2yr +8%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY15-FY24 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +5.7%/yr (Q1 cc guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22 median

BULL.desc: EPS +10.4%/yr (FY15-FY24 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +24.9%/yr (best 2-yr run FY15-FY24 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: RCL (retrospective, 2025-04-17) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.44x (17.0% downside to Bear $160 / +38.6% upside to Bull $267) | Adj composite 2.41 vs market 2.55: gap -0.14 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +33% above the EPP floor $145 (10x FY25E $14.50) | Conservative 2-yr case: +8.4% total (+4.2%/yr) | At 13.3x FY25E the 15% hurdle price $255 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; Net Yields +7.0% in Q4 2024, forward net revenue +8-8.51% (Q1 2025 net revenue guide at constant currency); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
